violation_type.title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. An incident occurred where a child required hospitalization on 06/07/2023. The incident was not reported to Child Care Regulation (CCR) timely; the incident was reported to CCR on 06/15/2023.
